name: ESP32-S3 Infrastructure Agent v1.2.2 — Portal and Core Logging Fix
purpose: Complete first installation; replaces all 16 MiB including existing identity/data. Not a data-preserving update.
provisioning: On-device captive portal. Join RiscRTE-Setup (password RiscRTE-Setup), open http://192.168.4.1/, enter Wi-Fi and choose a private pairing file. Public image has no credentials.
startup_status: Fixes station-only board permissions that denied captive-portal AP startup and shared native USB capacity accounting that discarded status lines over 128 bytes. Core USB defaults to 8 KiB independently of stage logging. Host regressions and target build pass; physical SSID/portal qualification remains pending.
